name: Lala Satalin Deviluke
original_name: ララ・サタリン・デビルーク
source:
The princess of Deviluke. Acts childish and often scatterbrained. Nevertheless she is an intellect and passionate girl. She carries with her a bizarre amount of gadgets that often leads to obscure results.

Back at home, she was often forced by her father to marry a suitor, but she refused them all and ran away to Earth. Now, she ends up in Rito where she insists on taking him as her husband. From that point on, she stayed on Earth while incorporating this facade.
